=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:377-384 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `existing_was_draft` is referenced in the auto-merge failure handler even though it is only defined on the existing-PR path.
  WHY: For a newly created PR, an auto-merge failure reaches the exception block without `existing_was_draft` being defined, causing a `NameError`; reviewers disagreed only on surrounding behavior, not on the bug itself.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:20-21 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow declares only `contents: read` while the job performs write operations such as pushing commits and creating or editing PRs.
  WHY: The declared permissions are insufficient for the runner’s write actions, so fallback use of `github.token` can fail with 403 errors; all reviewers agreed on the permission mismatch.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:359-396 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: When validation succeeds but auto-merge enablement fails, the PR body is rebuilt as if the refresh were red.
  WHY: The code reports a false-negative status in the PR description after a successful refresh; reviewers disagreed on some surrounding details, but not on the misleading status.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:122 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification message uses `\n` inside double quotes, so bash treats it as a literal backslash-n.
  WHY: The alert text will show `\n` instead of an actual newline, reducing readability.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:220-227 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The refresh pipeline clears `GH_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` for render/lint/self_test stages.
  WHY: Any validation step that needs authenticated repository access will fail despite a valid workflow PAT, although one reviewer considered this intentional.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:505-511 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `main()` catches only `ValueError` from loading the repositories file.
  WHY: Missing or unreadable repos files raise uncaught file errors and produce a raw stack trace instead of a clean error message.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:274 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `git add -A` stages all repository changes.
  WHY: This can accidentally include unrelated files or temporary artifacts in the refresh commit.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:198-210 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The default-branch fallback hardcodes `main` when `gh repo view` fails.
  WHY: Repositories using another default branch, such as `master`, can fail later when the fallback branch does not exist.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:288-299 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `gh pr list --head` uses `owner:branch` for the head filter.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that this can miss existing same-repo PRs and trigger duplicate creation attempts.
- README.md:15561-15577 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Nested list items in the “Validation Refresh Automation” section are not properly indented.
  WHY: The markdown renders the sub-items as top-level bullets, degrading readability.
- README.md:1564-1576 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Nested list items under “Triggers:”, “Runtime:”, “PR behavior:”, and “Failure/no-op behavior:” are not indented.
  WHY: The markdown renders those items as top-level bullets, degrading readability.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:377-383 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: New PRs are not converted to draft on auto-merge failure because `undo_ready` is set to `False`.
  WHY: The reviewer states the failure path leaves new green PRs ready instead of draft, which conflicts with the intended fallback behavior.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:224-227 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runner clears auth tokens for validation stages that may need them.
  WHY: The reviewer says consumer repositories with private dependencies or internal artifacts can fail even when a PAT is available.
- tests/test_validation_refresh_runner.py:undefined | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test suite lacks coverage for the green auto-merge failure path when the PR is newly created.
  WHY: The reviewer says the existing test only covers the existing-PR scenario, leaving the new-PR path untested.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:382 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The variable `existing_was_draft` is referenced in the `except CommandFailure` block but is only defined in the `if existing_prs:` branch.
  WHY: When a new PR is created (the `else:` branch), `existing_prs` is an empty list, so `existing_was_draft` is never defined. If `gh pr merge --auto` fails, the `except` block attempts to read `existing_was_draft` to set `undo_ready`, causing a `NameError` crash.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:359 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When validation passes but auto-merge enablement fails, the call to `_build_pr_body` uses `green=False`.
  WHY: This incorrectly reports the PR status as "red (one or more refresh checks failed)" in the PR description, which is misleading. The refresh was actually successful; only the automation for merging it failed.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:20-21 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Workflow permissions are set to `contents: read`, which is insufficient for the `git push` and `gh pr` operations performed by the runner.
  WHY: While the job uses a PAT via `GH_TOKEN`, it's best practice to declare explicit permissions. More importantly, if the PAT is ever missing or narrow-scoped, the default `github.token` fallback will fail with 403 Forbidden because it lacks `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write`.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:122 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification uses `\n` inside double quotes in a bash `run:` block.
  WHY: Bash does not interpret `\n` as a newline inside double quotes. The notification will contain a literal backslash and 'n'.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:220-221 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The environment overrides for the refresh pipeline (`render`, `lint`, `self_test`) explicitly clear `GH_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
  WHY: If the repository's validation scripts or `render_validation_templates.py` need to access private dependencies or invoke the `gh` CLI for any reason, they will fail even if the runner was provided with a valid `GH_PAT`.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:506-511 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `main()` catches only `ValueError` from `load_target_repositories()`.
  WHY: If the `repos-file` is missing (e.g. invalid path provided to manual dispatch), `FileNotFoundError` will be raised. This won't be caught, causing a raw stack trace instead of the intended clean error summary.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:331, 377-381 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The variable `existing_wa...` is defined inside the `if existing_prs:` block but is referenced in the `except CommandFailure` block for both existing and new PRs.
  WHY: When a NEW PR is created and auto-merge enable fails, the code references `existing_wa...` even though it was never assigned on that path, causing a `NameError` at runtime.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:20-21 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow declares only `contents: read` permission, but it performs write operations including git push, creating PRs, and merging.
  WHY: When `GH_PAT` is unavailable, the workflow falls back to `github.token` which inherits read-only permissions, causing HTTP 403 errors.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:391-396 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When validation is green but auto-merge enable fails, the code builds the PR body with `green=False`.
  WHY: Users viewing the PR will see "Status: red (one or more refresh checks failed)" even though validation actually passed and only auto-merge was not enabled.
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:~117-122 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification uses `TEXT="...\n..."` inside double quotes, so bash does not interpret `\n` as a newline.
  WHY: The message shows literal backslash-n text instead of line breaks.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:212-220 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pipeline environment overrides set `GH_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` to empty strings, which can break validation steps that need authenticated access.
  WHY: If a consumer repository's validation scripts require private dependencies or artifacts, the refresh pipeline will fail despite a valid PAT.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:506-511 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `main()` catches only `ValueError` from `load_target_repositories()`, so missing or unreadable repo files can crash the script.
  WHY: A missing repositories file causes a stack trace instead of a clean error summary.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:288-299 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh pr list --head` lookup may fail to find existing PRs in some contexts.
  WHY: The reviewer says the `owner:branch` format can miss matches, causing duplicate-creation attempts that later fail with "pull request already exists".
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:~359 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `--auto` flag is used without checking whether the repository allows auto-merge.
  WHY: In repositories where auto-merge is disabled, every refresh PR will be forced to draft even if validation passed.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:198-210 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: If `gh repo view` fails, the code falls back to `"main"` as the default branch.
  WHY: Some repositories use `master` or another branch name, so subsequent checkout can fail.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:274 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Using `git add -A` could accidentally include unrelated changes outside the validation directory.
  WHY: Unintended files may be committed if the runner environment contains other modifications.
- README.md:15561-15577 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Nested list items in the "Validation Refresh Automation" section are not properly indented.
  WHY: The markdown renders the nested items as top-level bullets, degrading readability.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
